result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign** for simplicity and value, or **DocuSign** if you want the most established, widely recognized e-signature platform.

However, the best choice depends on how many documents you send, how many employees need access, and whether you need more than just signatures.

## My top 5 e-signature platforms for small businesses

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best overall for simplicity)

- Easy to use for clients and employees.
- Reusable document templates.
- Signature tracking and audit trails.
- Paid plans offer unlimited signature requests.
- Good for contracts, NDAs and agreements.

Pricing: From approximately US\$15/month.

[Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best for professionalism and trust)

- Widely recognized by customers and businesses.
- Strong security and audit trails.
- Excellent integrations.
- Advanced signing workflows.

Pricing: Entry plans around US\$11–15/month, depending on plan and billing.

[Visit DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/opy__qKCrCsIKnnF5NHqBYNkFSD9tFJxhM39aLVUKpNw8OxuNc3sSNOdGSyNGxaqIKKrmce4TuaVLmGO9eSbwlpx_ArOoLhxrlRmtBC9tAc0Mt_Es7zHktC9aUhmHT5EUOLg6P9MGqBrXjzTrjD1lx16SP7BAihCSKTMGiqzFSlJl3OCCns1gQY78yXl07V_?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc**

(Best for sales and proposals)

- Create professional proposals and contracts.
- Add pricing tables and payment options.
- Track when customers open documents.
- Reusable templates and electronic signatures.

Pricing: From approximately US\$19/user/month.

[Visit PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![SignWell Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Jr7ERfTZr0cqqbqtQojc1WgFegKKLiPrJurgeTes_GrO9qxMF5YkVG9gVLeB9qvt7YBC6Q6pkJBI9N_c51xLlztOk6hKzac7E4lFA8rd9eBpetTe_xy1klt7wGh6uRBKJslwwXSnJXsHHrXPP9HSa1AdMDl53XAX_hATAxwkkaXeQ7t2kL5k6NsdkQn3lUlj?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. SignWell**

(Best budget option)

- Very straightforward interface.
- Free plan for occasional signing.
- Templates and audit trails.
- Affordable paid plans.

Pricing: Free tier; paid plans around US\$10/month.

[Visit SignWell](https://www.signwell.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Logo Wordmark PNG Vector - BrandLogo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/95na-wLQUN9p7GmfVbVlsMH9WIm3-bHOmsuOzR4w7FH_LNHajHgaUKajbYSFfuQalq9gsQjPtmcFPYYjJQoXKBtI8uyMeQC8oBjmdwkaHvf0cQn2ZgYIR22CA9JGfELZMa-MGbcgzYfhWePcbsbIj2Mlr0RTRu05Ww7rIP3mtZmaOkamqppjBubOBDVYwJ7W?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

(Best for PDF workflows)

- Edit and prepare PDFs.
- Collect electronic signatures.
- Manage document workflows.
- Good Microsoft 365 integration.

Pricing: From approximately US\$16.99/month for relevant plans.

[Visit Adobe Acrobat Sign](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/sign.html)

These are approximate US-dollar starting prices, not guaranteed Canadian billing prices. Plan limits and features vary. ## Quick comparison

| Software | Best use | My assessment |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Dropbox Sign | Everyday contracts | Best balance |
| DocuSign | Professional agreements | Most established |
| PandaDoc | Sales proposals | Most features |
| SignWell | Basic signing | Best budget |
| Adobe Sign | PDF management | Best PDF integration |


## What I'd choose

If I were setting up an e-signature system for a small business\:

- **Simple client contracts\:** Dropbox Sign.
- **Employment agreements and business contracts\:** DocuSign.
- **Quotes, proposals and sales agreements\:** PandaDoc.
- **Keeping costs low\:** SignWell.

One important consideration if you're operating in Canada: check Canadian legal requirements, PIPEDA/privacy obligations where applicable, audit-trail capabilities, and whether Canadian data residency is required for your business. A US ESIGN compliance claim alone doesn't establish Canadian compliance.
